findings.summary: attempts counts earlier failures, so the fifth failed attempt sees 4 and is released; messages are attempted six times, not five.
PermanentFailure subclasses DeliveryError, so the DeliveryError clause catches it first; rejected 4xx messages are retried to exhaustion and the PermanentFailure branch is unreachable.
claim_batch selects pending rows and then updates them by id without re-checking state in one transaction, so two dispatchers can claim and deliver the same message.
dead_letter deletes the row instead of setting state dead with the error, so dead letters are lost and dead_letters and replay never find them.
